messages:
Gwen - Design: quick note from today's design review: the filters panel in Model Catalog is a bit confusing when stacked with the version pin modal. users thought the button toggled something in the modal.
Marco - Eng: which button text are we using now? 'Show filters'?
Gwen - Design: yeah. i'd prefer 'Filters panel' or 'Open filters panel' to make it explicit the panel is separate. also the expand animation causes a brief loss of keyboard focus.
Elliott (PM): +1 on clearer copy. small ask: include a tooltip with a keyboard shortcut hint so power users find it quickly.
Priya - QA: repro notes: on macOS VoiceOver the focus disappears for ~150ms during the slide. also when you pin a version only the icon toggles — VO doesn't announce the change.
a11y-scan: issue: missing aria-live on pin action; prefers-reduced-motion not honored for .panel-transition; contrast warning on .filter-label (ratio 3.6:1).
Marco - Eng: plan: 1) add aria-live polite status update when pin/unpin occurs (e.g., 'Pinned version v3.2'), 2) respect prefers-reduced-motion via CSS media query, 3) keep focus visible by moving it into the panel container before transition completes.
Gwen - Design: for copy let's decide between 'Filters panel' and 'Open filters panel' — lean 'Filters panel' (shorter) but show shortcut in tooltip.
Elliott (PM): choose 'Filters panel' now and file an i18n key for the tooltip with placeholder for shortcut. l10n-bot will pick it up.
l10n-bot: noted: new key required filters.panel.button and tooltip key filters.panel.shortcut. please include context for translators.
Priya - QA: can we also reserve horizontal space for performance badges in the compare row so they don't shift when the panel toggles? Tests showed a 6px jump today.
Marco - Eng: yep — will set a stable width for the badge container and use flex-grow on descriptive text. small CSS patch.
Gwen - Design: thanks — also update focus color to match high-contrast token so the ring is obvious during transitions.
Elliott (PM): priority: high for aria-live and reduced-motion this sprint. copy + badge reserve next sprint unless Marco can sneak both in.
Marco - Eng: i'll do aria-live + reduced-motion now, and try to include badge width reserve in the same PR. will add VO repro steps.
Gwen - Design: i'll update the design note with before/after GIF and add the keyboard shortcut microcopy.
a11y-scan: closing note: addressing these will resolve two critical a11y findings and improve VoiceOver UX.
Priya - QA: assigning verification to me once PR lands. thanks everyone.
